hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored multiscaleEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_multiscale (MSEn) BIT-FOR-BIT across scales 1-8; and the MSE curve is non-monotonic, rising to a coarse-scale peak that exceeds the scale-1 value (the signature of multi-scale structure, not white noise).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: multiscaleEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_multiscale to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 across scales 1-8)
